subject: ela

applicable_programme.grade_mapping_note: PYP covers ages 3-12; our Grade 4 mapping (typically age 9-10) is within the programme but is our convention, not an IB-specified grade boundary.

grade_specific_note.label: C
grade_specific_note.text: Grade 4 students in PYP language development typically engage in more complex text analysis, develop argumentative and expository writing, explore multiple perspectives in literature, and apply research skills across inquiry units.

subject_group_or_structure.mapping_to_primer_subject: PYP Language encompasses oral language, visual language, and written language across three strands: comprehending, producing, and word study. This maps to our ELA subject.

concepts: Causation - Why is it like it is?
Connection - How is it connected to other things?
Perspective - What are the points of view?
global_contexts_or_transdisciplinary_the: Where we are in place and time

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: PYP Language Scope and Sequence covers comprehending (listening, reading, viewing), producing (speaking, writing, presenting), and word study (vocabulary, spelling, conventions).

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: Language learning is developed through phases, with students moving through constructing meaning, transferring meaning, and applying with understanding.

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: Language is the major connector across the curriculum and is embedded within all transdisciplinary units of inquiry.

typical_fit.label: C
typical_fit.text: At Grade 4, PYP language learners typically: analyze how literary elements contribute to meaning, explain author perspectives and claims, write with multiple sources and organizational structures, and apply Greek/Latin roots. These align with Florida B.E.S.T. standards for reading (ELA.4.R), writing (ELA.4.C), and vocabulary (ELA.4.V).

suggested_alignment_to_florida_and_arizo.label: C

florida.alignment_note: Explaining theme with details aligns with PYP Comprehending strand's focus on meaning-making.
Author's claims and evidence aligns with PYP critical thinking through research skills.
Argumentative writing aligns with PYP Producing strand and principled communication.
Research with multiple sources aligns with PYP research skills ATL.
Greek/Latin roots aligns with PYP word study strand.

suggested_alignment_to_florida_and_arizo.notes: Arizona standards deferred. These alignments are suggested starting points (Label C), not official IB-Florida mappings.
